cohort: 31 women who underwent peripartum hysterectomy for management of hemorrhage, and 19,902 control women
finding: After adjustment for maternal age and twin pregnancy, placenta previa, prior cesarean delivery, previous myomectomy, and ART conception were all antenatal predictors for peripartum hysterectomy.
mod_finding: This study found that women who conceived after assisted reproductive technology (ART) had a higher risk of requiring a peripartum hysterectomy.
